concepts.gloss_en: The festival (regel/pilgrimage-festival) as the revelation of the Will

members.form: רגל ויום טוב שהוא התגלות הרצון
members.note: Same passage (lm2:4), same predicate 'התגלות הרצון'; adds coordinate 'ויום טוב' (festival day) as a near-synonymous gloss of רגל — same referent in this usage, not a distinct construct head

notes: Both cite the identical proof in lm2:4; 'ויום טוב' is an appositional expansion of רגל, not a different possessed/construct head. Merged as 'likely' rather than 'obvious' since it is not a pure orthographic variant.
